title: Amazon Launches Bee AI Wearables Starting at $75 to Summarize Conversations
summary:
The company released the Bee Frontier wristband and Bee Eclipse phone attachment to capture spoken conversations and convert them into reminders and to-do lists. The $74.99 Bee Frontier offers a 7 day battery life, while the magnetic Bee Eclipse attachment starts at $99.99 and lasts more than 21 days. Amazon stated that audio is processed in real time and is never stored.

The hardware integrates with Alexa+ and Amazon to provide personalized assistance and shopping recommendations. A monthly subscription to Bee Pro for the devices costs $12. The system is designed to remember daily interactions and transform them into concisely written summaries to help users track their activity.
